questions.prompt: A measurement has unbiased normal error with standard deviation \( 0.2 \). The average of \( 3 \) readings is \( 10.3 \), while the true value is \( 10 \). Find the z-score of the observed sample mean.
questions.answer: The sample mean error has standard deviation \( 0.2/\sqrt{3}=0.1155 \). Therefore \[z=\frac{10.3-10}{0.1155}=2.6.\] This measures how many standard errors the observed mean is from the true value.
